principles: Exclusions are set by drug class using a published criterion, not by drug-by-drug judgment.
An excluded medication is recognized but deliberately NOT assessed. The app must show a message distinct from 'no data'.
Exclusion of these medications does not imply that any other medication is safe. Every result states this.
The app never assumes a clinical indication it cannot establish. Indication-dependent entries resolve to NEEDS_CLARIFICATION.
Matching uses normalized RxNorm ingredient identifiers (IN/PIN RxCUIs), never free-text names alone.

A therapeutic-class label alone never excludes a drug. Only listed ingredient rules exclude; a class signal on an unlisted ingredient follows the class's unlisted_signal_behavior (NEEDS_CLARIFICATION by default).
An applicable exclusion always overrides inclusion in the supported-drug catalog.

classes.rationale: A small error in dose or quality can cause serious bleeding or clotting. Warfarin and the newer anticoagulants carry boxed warnings for these risks, per FDA labels (not yet checked against current versions).
classes.explanation: Blood thinners (anticoagulants) are not assessed by this app because a small error in identification or quality interpretation could have serious consequences. This is a policy choice, not a finding about the medication.

classes.rationale: Levels that drop too low risk organ rejection, and levels that run too high risk toxicity. Clinicians monitor these drugs with blood tests.
classes.explanation: Transplant immunosuppressants are not assessed by this app because their levels are closely monitored by clinicians and small differences matter. This is a policy choice, not a finding about the medication.

route_rules.interim_behavior: Non-oral products are outside MVP formulation scope and resolve to UNSUPPORTED with reason ADMINISTRATION_RULE_PENDING. No rule is invented.
